settings.heading:
Every bed in the building,
made to order.
settings.lede: Hotels, serviced apartments, short lets and developments. Built to your specification in any quantity, in the size the room takes, and delivered room by room.

settings.label: Any size we can make
settings.text: Fifteen sizes as standard, British, European, American and Australian. If a room takes 160 by 200 or 183 by 213, that is what goes in it.

settings.label: One specification across the estate
settings.text: Every room the same build, the same depth, the same feel. A guest moving between properties finds the same bed.

settings.label: A comfort layer you replace, not a mattress
settings.text: The top five centimetres are what wear. Renew the layer and the core stays. On a hundred rooms that is the difference between a refurbishment and a delivery.

settings.label: Delivered room by room
settings.text: Concierged to each room, unrolled, positioned, packaging taken away. Old mattresses removed and recycled on the same visit.

settings.heading: What a made-to-order supplier changes
settings.body:
Contract mattresses are bought from stock, which means the size range is whatever the warehouse holds and the specification is whatever was made last quarter. Rooms get fitted around the mattress.

Nothing is built before you order it. So the bed fits the room, rather than the other way round.

settings.heading: Hotels
settings.text: From a single floor to a full estate. One specification, phased delivery, and a comfort layer that renews between refurbishment cycles.

settings.heading: Serviced apartments
settings.text: Mixed room sizes and high turnover. European King and Split King for continental frames and twin configurations.

settings.heading: Short lets and holiday homes
settings.text: Small quantities, high scrutiny. The mattress is the most reviewed object in the property.

settings.heading: Property developers
settings.text: Furnished handover at scale. Specification agreed once, delivered against a completion schedule.

settings.heading: Interior designers
settings.text: Sizes to suit the room rather than the catalogue, and a build specification you can put in a schedule.

settings.heading: Care and residential
settings.text: Durability and a renewable surface, with a core guaranteed for twenty five years.

settings.heading: Sizes
settings.lede: Fifteen as standard. Anything with both dimensions at or under 213 centimetres can be quoted.
settings.table_note: Every size, one construction. Thirty five centimetres, pocket sprung core, removable comfort layer.

settings.label: Specification
settings.text: Sizes, quantities, and any variation on the standard build. We will send a sample to the property if it helps the decision.

settings.label: Quotation
settings.text: Priced against quantity, with delivery scheduled to your dates rather than ours.

settings.label: Production
settings.text: Built to the order. Lead times are confirmed at quotation and held.

settings.label: Delivery and installation
settings.text: Room by room, unrolled and positioned. Old mattresses removed and recycled on the same visit.

settings.label: Renewal
settings.text: Comfort layers reordered as the estate needs them, without replacing a single core.

settings.heading: Talk to us about a project
settings.lede: Tell us the property, the number of rooms and the sizes you need. If you do not know the sizes yet, tell us the rooms and we will work them out.

settings.heading: One specification, every room.
settings.text: Built to order, so the bed fits the room rather than the room fitting the bed.

settings.heading: It arrives finished.
settings.text: Concierged. Room by room. Unrolled and positioned. The old ones leave with it.

settings.heading: It stays right for twenty five years.
settings.text: The part that softens renews. The part that lasts, lasts.

settings.heading:
A bed that becomes yours,
and stays that way.
